source_observations.assessment: Pauldron generate_limb_armor_on validates fit, records carrier and plates/shells, submits, explicitly reads carrier status and rejects nonzero. Its record_limb_armor sibling returns the recorded plates without this explicit status read, while carrier record separately validates the pauldron design. Other limb shape validates design before part build. All observations are static source control flow; no GPU operation ran.

V2/V3 are f64 arrays; pattern source uses them for edge-local curvature parameters and for panel vertices, translation and degree-valued rotation. They are representation aliases rather than admitted finite/frame/unit contracts. Exactly the two original lines were read old and current; unrelated math helpers remain unread.

Private PartingGroupId is produced by nonnegative i32 decoding or default zero, so its current gpu_word i32 cast is representable; negatives encode Unassigned. StrandId is stable identity independent of array position. lane requires positive lanes and public/Serde Lanes count can be zero; group() itself reaches inverted clamp first in the shown braid call. Ordinary braid selector uses 3. Prior q162 and q372 remain connected, not counted again.

ContactPrecision constructor asserts finite nonnegative input; armor resolves edge/blunt and a single padding budget into resisted/transmitted/penetrated energy and emits an outcome. The selected caller passes attack force and chosen surface. The fixed absolute debug conservation threshold and externally supplied surface/force values need source-producer and numeric-policy tracing; no erroneous behavior or bad supported combat input demonstrated. Existing tests at 90–138 were source text only, never run.

ShellPlan admits nonzero count, nonempty triple indices within count and consistent paired edge direction, then constructs outer/inner/edge faces and native high-bit source encoding. Layout sums carrier/final counts, narrows source length to u32 and offsets packed indices. Checked native capacity, global offset, valid geometry and allocator/device limits remain open; earlier 95e pauldron assessment already records the same large-count capacity question. Original tests 134–177 remain excluded, though current navigation displayed selected matching lines and receipt lists them.

Current generic garment math aliases are format/calculation representations; PanelSpec field context, not a generic array alias, determines coordinate frame and unit. No requirement to wrap every kernel scalar was established.

Hair unassigned uses an explicit host enum and a native negative sentinel at the interface; no obsolete compatibility fallback is inferred. Current private Assigned constructors bound the signed conversion.
Shell face variants derive in the same plan as indices. This does not by itself certify geometric manifoldness, downstream buffer length or runtime output.

thirteen_lenses.producer_propagation: Hair lane producer flows through group and integration; current default braid count is three. Limb shape validates authored design, but native device frame/status callers still require connected tracing.
thirteen_lenses.existing_type_owners: Stable StrandId, group membership and current ordinal are distinct; V2/V3 alias does not by itself prove semantic frame. ContactPrecision has finite nonnegative admission but its callers and energy producers remain separate.
thirteen_lenses.admission_contracts: Parting public count lacks enforced positivity; shell topology checks basic capacity/index/edge relations but not packed-bit count in these bodies. ArmorSurface fields are public raw inputs; current invalid producer is unproved.
thirteen_lenses.invariant_operations: Existing zero/large lane arithmetic and shell offset/narrowing questions retained. Combat conservation assertion uses absolute 0.001 and requires numeric-scale policy; no numerical failure claimed.
thirteen_lenses.aggregate_states: Shell sources, indices and faces are produced together. PartLayout aggregation and component/readback require capacity and buffer relationships across shells; topology and geometric validity are distinct.
thirteen_lenses.type_ownership: Hair identity is host membership, shell source encodes armor topology and combat energy belongs selected impact. Do not merge their native integer or scalar representations.
thirteen_lenses.redundant_authority: Camera original distinguishes contact outcome from scaled effects; energy channels and outcome carry related stage-specific facts. Carrier status must be propagated rather than invented as an independent parallel authority.
thirteen_lenses.behavior_preservation: All assigned bodies match old/current per-file, but prior excluded scopes and consumers still require fresh evidence. Preserve intentional unassigned and zero-width/none cases; no whole snapshot equivalence.
thirteen_lenses.enum_shapes: PartingGroup explicitly separates unassigned from assigned; VertexSource distinguishes inner/outer prior to ABI packing; ArmorImpactOutcome does not automatically own mutually exclusive energy payloads.
thirteen_lenses.derivability: Faces are derived from same plan indices/count; do not introduce independent writable redundant face authority. Provenance and frame identity need actual consumers, not blind derive.
thirteen_lenses.type_granularity: V2/V3 are generic native array dimensions; panel translation, rotation and 2D curvature are different roles. Precision is not a damage category; parting count bounds not global StrandId bounds.
thirteen_lenses.magic_strings: Native WGSL/source labels, device batch label and serde boundary representations have different functions; static words and test names are not automatically product identities.
thirteen_lenses.magic_numbers: Bit31 is a concrete native packing discriminator, lane count3 is braid policy, energy 0.5 and absolute 0.001 are equation/tolerance choices. Trace owners and limits rather than reflexive constants.
